svg.title: From random the input projections end at 93 to 221 active subcomponents with fits of 0.40 to 0.87. From the neurons they end at 125 to 248 active with fits of 0.71 to 0.88.
svg.text: From the neurons, input projections keep more active and fit far better
Each dot is one layer's input projection, moving through training from step 5,000
to 49,999. Measured every 2,000 steps on the training run's 8 held-out pieces.
